purpose: The DayZ items that carry a hero's powers. Wearing one in the gloves slot grants the listed abilities. Each row generates one config class and one power-mask entry.

base_class.doc: Vanilla DayZ class inherited for model, slot and textures.

required_addon.doc: CfgPatches addon that defines base_class; added to requiredAddons so it loads first.

slot.doc: Inventory slot the item is worn in.

rows.description: Wear them to web-swing (X), crawl walls (jump at a wall), Get Over Here! (T) and Web-Cluster (B).

_unverified.base_class: Script class exists in 1.29; confirm the config class spawns and shows in the gloves slot in game.
_unverified.required_addon: Named by analogy with DZ_Characters_Tops used in Bohemia's Test_ClothingRetexture sample; confirm the mod loads without a missing-addon error.

rows.description: Wear them and your melee hits drain life into you. Area drain (X). Hit Spider-Man to steal his powers.
